```{r}
###############################################################################
# Rank Hallmark pathways by their MEAN ssGSEA score across the 4 PDOs
#   BO-046, BO-114, BO-189, BO-268
#
# WHY
#   The heatmap row order comes from hierarchical clustering. It is close to a
#   ranking but it is not one. This script ranks the pathways by the actual
#   mean score, so "Top 5" and "Bottom 5" on a slide are real rankings.
#
# INPUT   PDO_ssGSEA_Hallmark_scores.csv  (pathways x PDOs, from
#         PDO_ssGSEA_Hallmark.R)
#
# WORKFLOW
#   1. Read scores (pathways x 4 PDOs)
#   2. Per pathway: mean, min, max, range (max - min), rank by mean,
#      rank inside each PDO, number of PDOs in which it is in the top 10
#   3. Tables: full ranking, top 5 / bottom 5, 10 pathways that differ most
#      between PDOs
#   4. Figures (dots = individual PDOs, black diamond = mean, grey line =
#      min to max): all 50 sorted; top 5 + bottom 5; most variable 10
#
# NOTES
#   - ssGSEA scores are relative to these 4 PDOs (normalize = TRUE rescales by
#     the range in this run). They cannot be compared directly with tumor
#     scores from another run.
#   - No statistical test is possible with 4 samples: the ranking is
#     descriptive.
#   - A top-ranked pathway is not necessarily specific to these PDOs: pathways
#     made of broadly expressed genes (e.g. MYC targets V1, oxidative
#     phosphorylation) score high in most proliferating samples.
#   - No dates in output file names.
###############################################################################

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2)
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(tibble)
})

SEED <- 42
set.seed(SEED)

# ------------------------------ 1. SETTINGS ----------------------------------
PDO_DIR     <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/RNASeq/PDO"
SCORES_FILE <- file.path(PDO_DIR, "PDO_ssGSEA_Hallmark_scores.csv")
OUT_DIR     <- PDO_DIR
dir.create(file.path(OUT_DIR, "plots"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

N_EXTREME <- 5    # how many top and bottom pathways to show
N_VARIABLE <- 10  # how many most variable pathways to show
TOP_K     <- 10   # "in the top K of a PDO" (for the shared-top check)

# Shown under every figure: no statistics are possible with one sample per PDO
CAPTION <- "Descriptive ranking only: one sample per PDO (n = 4, no replicates), no statistical test."

# ------------------------------ 2. READ SCORES -------------------------------
sc <- read.csv(SCORES_FILE, row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE)
rownames(sc) <- sub("^HALLMARK_", "", rownames(sc))
sc <- as.matrix(sc)
stopifnot(is.numeric(sc), !anyNA(sc))
pdos <- colnames(sc)
message("Pathways: ", nrow(sc), "; PDOs: ", paste(pdos, collapse = ", "))

pdo_cols <- setNames(c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3")[seq_along(pdos)], pdos)

# ------------------------------ 3. RANKING TABLE -----------------------------
rank_in_pdo <- apply(-sc, 2, rank, ties.method = "min")   # 1 = highest in that PDO

ranking <- data.frame(
  pathway    = rownames(sc),
  sc,
  mean_score = rowMeans(sc),
  min_score  = apply(sc, 1, min),
  max_score  = apply(sc, 1, max),
  check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL) %>%
  mutate(range_between_PDOs = max_score - min_score)

ranking$n_PDOs_in_top10 <- rowSums(rank_in_pdo <= TOP_K)
colnames(rank_in_pdo) <- paste0("rank_in_", colnames(rank_in_pdo))
ranking <- cbind(ranking, rank_in_pdo)

ranking <- ranking %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_score)) %>%
  mutate(rank_high_to_low = row_number(),
         rank_low_to_high = n() - rank_high_to_low + 1) %>%
  relocate(rank_high_to_low, rank_low_to_high, .after = pathway)
write.csv(ranking, file.path(OUT_DIR, "PDO_ssGSEA_Hallmark_ranking.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

top_n    <- ranking %>% slice_head(n = N_EXTREME) %>% mutate(group = paste0("Top ", N_EXTREME))
bottom_n <- ranking %>% slice_tail(n = N_EXTREME) %>% arrange(mean_score) %>%
  mutate(group = paste0("Bottom ", N_EXTREME))     # listed from the lowest score
write.csv(bind_rows(top_n, bottom_n),
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "PDO_ssGSEA_Hallmark_top5_bottom5.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

variable <- ranking %>% arrange(desc(range_between_PDOs)) %>% slice_head(n = N_VARIABLE)
write.csv(variable, file.path(OUT_DIR, "PDO_ssGSEA_most_variable_pathways.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

print(as_tibble(bind_rows(top_n, bottom_n) %>%
                  select(group, pathway, mean_score, min_score, max_score, n_PDOs_in_top10)),
      n = Inf)

# ------------------------------ 4. FIGURES -----------------------------------
pretty <- function(x) gsub("_", " ", x)

long <- as.data.frame(sc) %>%
  rownames_to_column("pathway") %>%
  pivot_longer(-pathway, names_to = "sample", values_to = "score")
summ <- ranking %>% select(pathway, mean_score, min_score, max_score)

# paths: pathways ordered from the top of the plot to the bottom
# grp:   optional named vector pathway -> facet label (row panels)
plot_dots <- function(paths, grp = NULL, title, subtitle) {
  lv <- rev(paths)                                   # first level plots at the bottom
  d  <- long %>% filter(pathway %in% paths) %>% mutate(pathway = factor(pathway, levels = lv))
  s  <- summ %>% filter(pathway %in% paths) %>% mutate(pathway = factor(pathway, levels = lv))
  if (!is.null(grp)) {
    glev <- unique(grp[paths])
    d$group <- factor(grp[as.character(d$pathway)], levels = glev)
    s$group <- factor(grp[as.character(s$pathway)], levels = glev)
  }
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_segment(data = s, aes(x = min_score, xend = max_score, y = pathway, yend = pathway),
                 colour = "grey65", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = d, aes(score, pathway, colour = sample), size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
    geom_point(data = s, aes(mean_score, pathway), shape = 18, size = 4.5, colour = "black") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = pdo_cols, name = "PDO") +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = pretty) +
    labs(x = "ssGSEA score", y = NULL, title = title, subtitle = subtitle,
         caption = CAPTION) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
  if (!is.null(grp)) {
    p <- p + facet_grid(group ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
      theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
  }
  p
}

sub_txt <- "Dots: individual PDOs. Black diamond: mean of the 4 PDOs.\nGrey line: min to max."

# 4a. all pathways, sorted by mean
p_all <- plot_dots(ranking$pathway, NULL,
                   "Hallmark ssGSEA scores in PDOs, ranked by mean", sub_txt)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "plots", "PDO_ssGSEA_ranked_all_pathways.png"),
       p_all, width = 9, height = 11.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "plots", "PDO_ssGSEA_ranked_all_pathways.pdf"),
       p_all, width = 9, height = 11.5)

# 4b. top and bottom pathways (for the slide)
ext_paths <- c(top_n$pathway, rev(bottom_n$pathway))      # highest ... lowest overall
ext_grp   <- setNames(c(rep(top_n$group[1], nrow(top_n)),
                        rep(bottom_n$group[1], nrow(bottom_n))), ext_paths)
p_ext <- plot_dots(ext_paths, ext_grp,
                   paste0("Top ", N_EXTREME, " and bottom ", N_EXTREME,
                          " Hallmark pathways\nby mean ssGSEA score"), sub_txt)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "plots", "PDO_ssGSEA_top5_bottom5.png"),
       p_ext, width = 8.5, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "plots", "PDO_ssGSEA_top5_bottom5.pdf"),
       p_ext, width = 8.5, height = 6)

# 4c. pathways that differ most between PDOs (largest max - min)
p_var <- plot_dots(variable$pathway, NULL,
                   paste0(N_VARIABLE, " pathways that differ most between PDOs"),
                   sub_txt)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "plots", "PDO_ssGSEA_most_variable_pathways.png"),
       p_var, width = 8.5, height = 5.5, dpi = 300)
ggsave(file.path(OUT_DIR, "plots", "PDO_ssGSEA_most_variable_pathways.pdf"),
       p_var, width = 8.5, height = 5.5)

message("Done. Outputs in: ", OUT_DIR)
sessionInfo()
```
